title: Add effort-split status line as mechanism for OLY-B-O4-02 (retry)
summary: Retry of rejected job 20261030-013413-fgct: add an `effort` line to `athena status` splitting recorded cost between study jobs and Athena's own work (change jobs plus steward, audience and auditor runs), record it as the OLY-B-O4-02 mechanism in docs/spec.toml, and replay it over real records against independent counts. Audience: the owner reading `athena status` and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the effort line against real records, not just that it exists.
A unit test fails without the mechanism; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
Behavior criteria run the status command and the tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261030-013413-fgct is addressed finding by finding. (1) Major, behavior criterion 4 lacked cited commands that ran: fixed by requiring the producer to run the status --snapshot command and cite its output as evidence, and by checking against sources that exist. (2) Minor, display.rs and snapshot.rs changed but were unlisted: both are now deliverables, and main.rs is dropped because it needs no change. (3) Minor, effort_lines inserted between specialization_lines and its doc comment: fixed by placing the new function so each keeps its own doc comment. (4) Minor, steward/audience/auditor runs left out of Athena's share: fixed by building the self side from Records::all_invocations, so runs outside study jobs count as Athena's own. (5) Nit, history.json has no capability trailers and is a 200-commit window against 471 landed jobs: the comparison now uses job.json capability fields and counts instead, and history.json is used only as a cross-check of the window. The prior candidate's work in CHANGELOG.md, display.rs, snapshot.rs, status.rs, status/planning.rs and docs/spec.toml is kept as the starting point, with the fixes above.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, status figure assembly), crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (figure functions over JobRecords, spent_usd, request_jobs), crates/athena-core/src/store.rs (Records::all_invocations, steward_runs, audience_runs, auditor_runs), crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs (feeds status --snapshot), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (status renderer). No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not touched. The xtask spec test requires each measure in docs/spec.toml to end with a status label that status prints.

Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/store.rs (all_invocations, reused unchanged) and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs; the `requirement` spec-gap list is reused for the 'what is not done is listed' half.

Environment: the real-records check reads the evidence snapshot directory with read-only access, covering job.json capability fields, recorded job and run costs, and history.json, a 200-commit window of landed commits. `git log` is read-only on the local checkout and only cross-checks that window. No push, no PR, no workflow is used.
Governance: athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows need no change; the change only reads existing status data and edits docs/spec.toml.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-O4-02 names the effort-split function in crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs and the `effort` status label as its mechanism, keeps owner Athena, and its measure ends with `status: effort`; Grep shows the function exists.

STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs has an ("effort", ...) entry and the renderer in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs prints a line starting with `effort`; each doc comment in display.rs stays directly above its own function (specialization_lines keeps its doc).

The effort self side is built from Records::all_invocations, so steward, audience and auditor runs outside study jobs are counted as Athena's own work; Grep of the effort-split function shows it does not sum request_jobs() alone.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a new unit test builds fixture records with study jobs, change jobs and a steward run of known costs and asserts the study and self shares including the steward cost; it fails when the effort-split function is stubbed out and passes with it. An empty record set yields an explicit 'no jobs recorded' line, not a zero share.

Run `cargo run -q -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>` on the real records and cite the command and its output: the `effort` line's job count is within the expected range taken from the independent count of job.json files with a capability field (listed with `ls` in the snapshot jobs directory) and does not exceed it; study and self shares sum to 100%; the study share matches recorded job costs of study-capability jobs. history.json and `git log` give only the 200-commit window and are used as a cross-check, not as the source of capability.

Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` from the repository root; all pass, including the xtask spec test that requires each measure to end with a status label.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the effort status line; the change adds no new refusal rule (expected 0% of newly refused readings).

out_of_scope: A new milestone gate or publish step
Changing the keep rule, planning cost, landing time or throughput figures
crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (dropped from the earlier list; no change needed)
Changing how steward, audience or auditor runs are recorded in store.rs
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than reference: this is a third attempt in a failing class and needs a real-records replay.
